routes.label: Calculate the products, add, then double

question: Calculate: \((5\times4+5\times3+4\times3)\times2=?\)
solution: Calculate the three products inside the parentheses first: \(5\times4=20\), \(5\times3=15\), and \(4\times3=12\). Their sum is \(20+15+12=47\); multiplying by 2 gives \(47\times2=94\).
